<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>M Conventions – Make Any Occasion Unforgettable | Visakhapatnam</title>
<meta name="description" content="M Conventions is a premier Visakhapatnam event venue in Kancharapalem offering wedding halls, corporate events, and full-service celebrations.">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --gold:#C9A84C;--gold-light:#E8D5A0;--cream:#FAF7F2;
  --dark:#1A1209;--dark-2:#2C2010;--border:rgba(201,168,76,0.25);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:96px}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--dark);color:var(--cream);overflow-x:hidden}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;padding:1rem 3rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(26,18,9,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.skip-link{position:absolute;top:1rem;left:1rem;z-index:1100;background:rgba(26,18,9,0.95);color:var(--cream);padding:0.75rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;transform:translateY(-120%);transition:transform 0.2s ease}
.skip-link:focus-visible{transform:translateY(0);outline:none}
.nav-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.8rem;text-decoration:none}
.nav-logo img{height:44px;width:auto}
.nav-logo-txt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);line-height:1}
.nav-logo-sub{font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.5);text-transform:uppercase}
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:none;padding:0.5rem;cursor:pointer;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.nav-toggle span{display:block;width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--cream);margin:4px 0;transition:transform 0.2s,opacity 0.2s}
.nav-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.nav-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.nav-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:1.8rem;list-style:none;align-items:center}
.nav-links a{font-size:0.8rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;opacity:0.8;transition:color 0.2s,opacity 0.2s}
.nav-links a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--gold)}
.nav-cta{background:var(--gold)!important;color:var(--dark)!important;padding:0.5rem 1.2rem;font-weight:500;opacity:1!important}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--gold-light)!important}

/* HERO */
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;padding:7rem 2rem 5rem}
.hero-slider{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0}
.hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}
.hero-slide.active{opacity:1}
.hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(26,18,9,0.65) 0%,rgba(26,18,9,0.85) 100%)}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:800px}
.hero-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.35rem 1.1rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;animation:fadeUp 0.8s ease forwards}
.hero-logo-img{width:120px;margin:0 auto 1.2rem;display:block;animation:fadeUp 0.8s 0.1s ease both}
.hero-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(3rem,7vw,6rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.05;color:var(--cream);animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.2s ease both}
.hero-title .gold{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.hero-tagline{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.25rem);font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-light);margin:0.6rem 0 1rem;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.3s ease both}
.hero-addr{font-size:0.78rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.6);letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:2rem;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.35s ease both}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.45s ease both}
.hero-rating{animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.55s ease both;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.6rem;margin-top:1.5rem;font-size:0.82rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.6)}
.hero-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:1rem}
.hero-stats{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:4rem;z-index:1;animation:fadeUp 0.9s 0.6s ease both}
.stat{text-align:center}
.stat-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);line-height:1}
.stat-label{font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.5);margin-top:0.25rem}
.btn-primary{background:var(--gold);color:var(--dark);padding:0.8rem 2rem;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s,transform 0.15s;display:inline-block}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--gold-light);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--cream);padding:0.8rem 2rem;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 0.2s,color 0.2s;display:inline-block}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}

/* SECTIONS */
section{padding:5.5rem 4rem}
.section-tag{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:0.7rem}
.section-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.15;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:1rem}
.section-title em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.section-desc{font-size:0.93rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.6);line-height:1.9;max-width:520px}
.gold-divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin:1.8rem 0}
.gold-divider::before,.gold-divider::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:0.4}
.gold-divider-icon{color:var(--gold);opacity:0.5;font-size:0.6rem}

/* ABOUT */
#about{background:var(--dark-2);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center}
.about-img-wrap{position:relative}
.about-img-main{width:100%;height:460px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--border);display:block}
.about-img-badge{position:absolute;bottom:-1.5rem;right:-1.5rem;background:var(--gold);color:var(--dark);padding:1.2rem;width:110px;height:110px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.badge-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.badge-txt{font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:0.25rem;font-weight:500}
.about-features{margin-top:2rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0.8rem}
.about-feat{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.7rem;padding:0.9rem;border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(201,168,76,0.04)}
.feat-icon{width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:0.85rem}
.feat-text{font-size:0.8rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.7);line-height:1.5}
.feat-text strong{display:block;color:var(--cream);font-weight:500;font-size:0.83rem;margin-bottom:0.1rem}

/* SERVICES */
#services{background:var(--dark);text-align:center}
.services-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);max-width:1100px;margin:3rem auto 0}
.service-card{background:var(--dark);padding:2.2rem 1.8rem;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.3s;position:relative}
.service-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--gold);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform 0.3s;transform-origin:left}
.service-card:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.06)}
.service-card:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.svc-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.5rem;color:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);font-weight:600;line-height:1;margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.svc-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:0.6rem}
.svc-desc{font-size:0.83rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.55);line-height:1.7}
.svc-arrow{display:inline-block;margin-top:1rem;font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);transition:opacity 0.3s,transform 0.3s}
.service-card:hover .svc-arrow{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}

/* GALLERY */
#gallery{background:var(--dark-2);text-align:center}
.gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);grid-template-rows:280px 280px;gap:6px;max-width:1100px;margin:3rem auto 0}
.gallery-item{position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.gallery-item:nth-child(1){grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 1}
.gallery-item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform 0.5s ease}
.gallery-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.gallery-caption{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(26,18,9,0.85) 0%,transparent 55%);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:1.2rem;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.35s}
.gallery-item:hover .gallery-caption{opacity:1}
.gallery-caption-txt{font-size:0.75rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-light)}

/* TESTIMONIALS */
#testimonials{background:var(--dark);text-align:center}
.testimonials-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5rem;max-width:1100px;margin:3rem auto 0}
.t-card{background:var(--dark-2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.8rem;text-align:left}
.t-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:0.8rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem}
.t-quote{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.5rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:0.25;line-height:1;margin-bottom:0.3rem}
.t-text{font-size:0.86rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.7);line-height:1.8;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.t-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.8rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:1rem}
.t-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;flex-shrink:0}
.t-name{font-size:0.83rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--cream)}
.t-event{font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.4);margin-top:0.1rem}
.google-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;background:rgba(201,168,76,0.08);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.5rem 1.2rem;margin-top:2.5rem;font-size:0.78rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.6);text-decoration:none;transition:border-color 0.2s}
.google-badge:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.google-badge strong{color:var(--gold)}

/* FACILITIES */
#facilities{background:var(--dark-2);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr;gap:5rem;align-items:start}
.fac-list{margin-top:2rem}
.fac-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.1rem;padding:1.1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:padding-left 0.2s}
.fac-item:hover{padding-left:0.4rem}
.fac-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:1rem;transition:background 0.2s,border-color 0.2s}
.fac-item:hover .fac-icon{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.1);border-color:var(--gold)}
.fac-name{font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--cream)}
.fac-sub{font-size:0.76rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.5);margin-top:0.12rem}
.fac-img-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;position:sticky;top:5rem}
.fac-img-box{overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:1}
.fac-img-box img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform 0.4s}
.fac-img-box:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}

/* WHY */
#why{background:var(--dark);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center}
.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.2rem}
.why-card{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.6rem;background:rgba(201,168,76,0.03);transition:border-color 0.2s,background 0.2s}
.why-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(201,168,76,0.07)}
.wc-icon{font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.wc-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:0.4rem}
.wc-text{font-size:0.8rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.55);line-height:1.7}

/* FAQ */
#faq{background:var(--dark-2)}
.faq-inner{max-width:740px;margin:0 auto}
.faq-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:2.5rem}
.faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.faq-q{width:100%;background:none;border:none;color:var(--cream);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.92rem;font-weight:500;text-align:left;padding:1.3rem 0;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1rem;transition:color 0.2s}
.faq-q:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.faq-toggle{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);flex-shrink:0;transition:transform 0.3s;font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height 0.4s ease;font-size:0.86rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.6);line-height:1.9}
.faq-a-inner{padding-bottom:1.3rem}
.faq-item.open .faq-toggle{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:200px}

/* CONTACT */
#contact{background:var(--dark);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem}
.contact-details{margin-top:2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
.c-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:1rem;padding:1.1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(201,168,76,0.03)}
.c-icon{font-size:1.1rem;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:0.1rem}
.c-label{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.25rem}
.c-val{font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.6}
.c-val a{color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none}
.c-val a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.c-open{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;margin-top:0.25rem}
.c-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#4CAF50}
.c-open-txt{font-size:0.74rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.5)}
.contact-form{background:var(--dark-2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:2.2rem}
.form-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:1.8rem}
.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.form-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.35rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.form-group label{font-size:0.7rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.5)}
.form-group input,.form-group select,.form-group textarea{background:var(--dark);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--cream);padding:0.7rem 0.9rem;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.88rem;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s;width:100%;appearance:none}
.form-group input:focus,.form-group select:focus,.form-group textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.form-group select option{background:var(--dark-2)}
.form-group textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:90px}
.form-submit{width:100%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--dark);border:none;padding:0.95rem;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s,transform 0.1s}
.form-submit:hover{background:var(--gold-light);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.form-success{display:none;text-align:center;padding:3rem 2rem}
.form-success-icon{font-size:2.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.form-success-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.5rem}
.form-success-sub{font-size:0.85rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.55);line-height:1.7}
.form-success-sub a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}

/* AI PLANNER */
#ai-planner{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--dark-2) 0%,var(--dark) 100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:0.85fr 1.15fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center}
.ai-console{border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(250,247,242,0.035);padding:1.2rem;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)}
.ai-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:0.9rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.ai-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.55rem;font-size:0.74rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.ai-pulse{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#4CAF50;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(76,175,80,0.55);animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
.ai-mini{font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.45)}
.ai-output{display:grid;gap:0.85rem}
.ai-card{border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.18);background:rgba(26,18,9,0.52);padding:1rem}
.ai-label{font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(201,168,76,0.8);margin-bottom:0.45rem}
.ai-value{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.2}
.ai-copy{font-size:0.82rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.62);line-height:1.7}
.ai-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0.85rem}
.ai-chip{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.85rem;background:rgba(201,168,76,0.04)}
.ai-chip strong{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.25rem}
.ai-chip span{font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.55);line-height:1.45}
.ai-actions{display:flex;gap:0.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.6rem}
.ai-btn{border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--cream);padding:0.75rem 1.1rem;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.76rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s,border-color 0.2s,color 0.2s}
.ai-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);background:rgba(201,168,76,0.06)}
.form-title-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.ai-form-badge{border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--gold);padding:0.35rem 0.65rem;font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.smart-note{border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.18);background:rgba(201,168,76,0.05);padding:0.85rem;margin-bottom:1rem;font-size:0.78rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.62);line-height:1.6}
.smart-note strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}

/* MAP */
#map-section{padding:0}
.map-wrap{position:relative}
.map-wrap iframe{width:100%;height:380px;border:none;display:block;filter:grayscale(50%)}
.map-card{position:absolute;top:2rem;left:2rem;background:rgba(26,18,9,0.92);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.5rem;max-width:270px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.map-card-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:0.5rem}
.map-card-addr{font-size:0.78rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.6);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.map-card-link{font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.4rem 0.9rem;display:inline-block;transition:background 0.2s}
.map-card-link:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.1)}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:#0D0A04;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:3rem 4rem 2rem}
.footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;padding-bottom:2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.footer-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.8rem;margin-bottom:0.8rem}
.footer-logo img{height:50px}
.footer-logo-txt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold)}
.footer-logo-sub{font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.4);text-transform:uppercase}
.footer-tagline{font-size:0.83rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.45);line-height:1.7;max-width:280px;margin-bottom:1rem}
.footer-social{display:flex;gap:0.6rem}
.footer-social a{width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.8rem;text-decoration:none;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.5);transition:border-color 0.2s,color 0.2s}
.footer-social a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.footer-col-title{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.footer-links{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.55rem}
.footer-links a{font-size:0.83rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.55);text-decoration:none;transition:color 0.2s}
.footer-links a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.footer-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(250,247,242,0.3)}

/* WHATSAPP */
.wa-btn{position:fixed;bottom:2rem;right:2rem;background:#25D366;color:white;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(37,211,102,0.3);z-index:999;transition:transform 0.2s}
.wa-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.08)}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(76,175,80,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(76,175,80,0)}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity 0.7s ease,transform 0.7s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:900px){
  nav{padding:1rem 1.5rem}
  .nav-toggle{display:flex}
  .nav-links{display:flex;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:rgba(26,18,9,0.98);padding:0 1.5rem;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height 0.25s ease}
  .nav-links.open{max-height:520px}
  .nav-links li{width:100%}
  .nav-links a{display:block;padding:0.9rem 0}
  section{padding:4rem 1.5rem}
  #about,#facilities,#why,#contact,#ai-planner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2.5rem}
  .services-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto}
  .gallery-item:nth-child(1){grid-column:span 2}
  .testimonials-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .ai-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .form-title-row{display:block}
  .ai-form-badge{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:1rem}
  .hero-stats{gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
  footer{padding:2rem 1.5rem}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem}
  .form-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .map-card{position:static;max-width:100%}
  .fac-img-grid{position:static}
}
</style>
</head>

        <div class="faq-a"><div class="faq-a-inner">M Conventions is equipped to host all kinds of events — weddings, receptions, ring ceremonies, sangeet nights, naming ceremonies, birthday parties, corporate events, conferences, product launches, and all social celebrations of any size.</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)">What is the guest capacity of the hall?<span class="faq-toggle">+</span></button>

      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">

      <div class="faq-item">

        <div class="faq-a"><div class="faq-a-inner">We are located at #56-1-26/2, Kancharapalem Main Road, Visakhapatnam – 530 008. Kancharapalem is right in the heart of the city, easy to reach from all directions, with ample parking on-site.</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">

      <div class="c-item"><div class="c-icon">📍</div><div><div class="c-label">Address</div><div class="c-val">#56-1-26/2, Kancharapalem Main Road,<br>Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh – 530 008</div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="contact-form reveal" style="transition-delay:0.15s">
    <div class="form-title">Send an Enquiry</div>
    <div id="enquiry-form">
      <div class="form-row">
        <div class="form-group"><label for="f-name">Your Name</label><input type="text" placeholder="Full name" id="f-name"></div>
        <div class="form-group"><label for="f-phone">Phone Number</label><input type="tel" placeholder="+91 XXXXX XXXXX" id="f-phone"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="form-group"><label for="f-event">Event Type</label><select id="f-event"><option value="">Select event type</option><option>Wedding / Reception</option><option>Corporate Event</option><option>Birthday Party</option><option>Naming Ceremony</option><option>Ring / Sangeet Ceremony</option><option>Social Celebration</option><option>Other</option></select></div>

<script>
// Slideshow
const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
let cur = 0;
setInterval(() => {
  slides[cur].classList.remove('active');
  cur = (cur + 1) % slides.length;
  slides[cur].classList.add('active');
}, 4000);

// Reveal
const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(e => { if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible'); }), {threshold:0.1});
reveals.forEach(r => obs.observe(r));

// FAQ
function toggleFaq(btn) {
  const item = btn.parentElement;
  const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
  if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
}

// Form
function submitForm() {
  const name = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
  const phone = document.getElementById('f-phone').value.trim();
  const event = document.getElementById('f-event').value;
  const date = document.getElementById('f-date').value;
  const guests = document.getElementById('f-guests').value.trim();
  const message = document.getElementById('f-msg').value.trim();
  if (!name || !phone || !event) { alert('Please fill in your name, phone number, and event type.'); return; }

  const enquiry = [
    'New Enquiry - M Conventions',
    '',
    'Name: ' + name,
    'Phone: ' + phone,
    'Event Type: ' + event,
    date ? 'Preferred Date: ' + date : '',
    guests ? 'Expected Guests: ' + guests : '',
    message ? 'Message: ' + message : ''
  ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');

  window.open('https://wa.me/919848011822?text=' + encodeURIComponent(enquiry), '_blank');
  document.getElementById('enquiry-form').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('form-success').style.display = 'block';
}

// Nav active
const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  let current = '';
  sections.forEach(s => { if(window.scrollY >= s.offsetTop - 100) current = s.id; });
  navLinks.forEach(a => { a.style.color = a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + current ? 'var(--gold)' : ''; });
});
</script>
